scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p packages/database && tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts && tsc --noEmit -p apps/jobs
scripts.test: pnpm test:recovery && pnpm test:unit --coverage && pnpm test:api && pnpm test:jobs && pnpm test:db && pnpm test:auth:integration
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @snapform/web build && pnpm --filter @snapform/api build && pnpm --filter @snapform/jobs build
scripts.check:fast: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint
scripts.check: pnpm types:generate && pnpm check:fast && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:bundle && pnpm test:preview && pnpm test:dev-reload
scripts.types:generate: pnpm --filter @snapform/api types && wrangler types --config apps/web/wrangler.jsonc apps/web/worker-configuration.d.ts && pnpm --filter @snapform/jobs types
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts .github/workflows package.json tsconfig.json vitest.unit.config.ts eslint.config.mjs pnpm-workspace.yaml .prettierrc.json drizzle.config.ts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts .github/workflows package.json tsconfig.json vitest.unit.config.ts eslint.config.mjs pnpm-workspace.yaml .prettierrc.json drizzle.config.ts
scripts.test:recovery: node --test --test-timeout=5000 scripts/recovery-archive.test.mjs scripts/backup-postgres.test.mjs scripts/recovery-manifest.test.mjs scripts/backup-r2.test.mjs scripts/backup-to-r2.test.mjs
